# Benchmark sources

Captured-page excerpts supplied by the owner; inspected 2026-10-28. No tests fetch sources. Capture replacement characters are retained.

- `excerpt-owasp-navigation.html`: https://genai.owasp.org/llm-top-10/; one original element from `owasp-llm-top10.html`. Skip-link CSS reduced to its clipping declaration.
- `excerpt-owasp-system.html`: https://genai.owasp.org/llmrisk/llm072025-system-prompt-leakage/; one original element from `owasp-llm07-sysprompt.html`. Surrounding main/body wrapper added.
- `excerpt-owasp-quoted.html`: https://genai.owasp.org/llmrisk/llm082025-vector-and-embedding-weaknesses/; one original element from `owasp-llm08-vector.html`. Surrounding main/body wrapper added.
- `excerpt-arxiv-accent.html`: https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2309.13994; one original element from `arxiv-2309.13994.html`. Surrounding main/body wrapper added.
- `excerpt-tsn-command.html`: https://tsn.readthedocs.io/en/latest/avb.html; one original element from `tsn-avb.html`. Surrounding main/body wrapper added.

All other files are original synthetic controls or harmless instructions using reserved placeholders. Hidden CSS cases reproduce the classes of findings reported on NASA, MIPI and Spellman pages; they are not excerpts and make no claim about unsaved markup.
